experiment: E092 discrimination test on E091 hand-classified labels with simplified instrument
ground_truth_experiment: E091 — read by hand: hand classification of E083 treatment queries as need statements
instrument: simplified_instrument: served if query contains at least one solution keyword ('how to','tutorial','guide','solution','fix','repair','troubleshoot','step by step','method','procedure') AND at least one specific domain term ('boeing','airbus','cockpit','avionics','hydraulic','pneumatic','engine','landing gear','electrical','flight control'). Unserved otherwise. This instrument operates on QUERY TEXT ONLY, no search results, no scrape data — deliberately not the classify_served / Bing + keywords class.
ground_truth: E091 hand classifications (35 queries from E083 treatment-needs.jsonl): served=14 (0.400), partial=4 (0.114), unserved=17 (0.486). Classifications written before viewing any search results or scrape data, per STATE.md §265 'labels known by construction'.

g1_discrimination_test.description: G1 per E088/PROTOCOL.md: served(known-unserved) ≤ 0.30 and Newcombe 95% CI of served(known-served) − served(known-unserved) excludes 0
g1_discrimination_test.g1_result: PASS — simplified instrument passes G1 discrimination on labels known by construction
g1_discrimination_test.key_finding: The simplified instrument (query-text-only, solution keyword + specific domain term) passes G1 discrimination on E091 hand-classified labels: 0/5 false positives on known-unserved, Newcombe CI95 lower bound 0.386 > 0. This is CONTRASTING with E088/E090 where the classify_served / Bing + keywords instrument produced 4/5 false positives and G1 FAILED. The 'read by hand' step (E091) providing 'labels known by construction' per STATE.md §265 is the enabling factor: without proper ground truth, no instrument can be fairly tested. With proper ground truth, a much simpler instrument suffices.

instrument_comparison.classify_served / Bing + keywords (E088,: G1 FAIL — 4/5 false positives, FPR=0.80, CI95 [0.376,0.964] spans 0.30
instrument_comparison.simplified instrument / query text only: G1 PASS — 0/5 false positives, FPR=0.000, CI95 lower bound 0.386 > 0

g1_discrimination_test.next_step_per_STATED_md: STATE.md §265: Discrimination test passed — instrument has passed muster on labels known by construction. The way is clear for population measurement. STATE.md §263: the 'read by hand' step has been taken. STATE.md §267: the next session must not start from classify_served over Bing in an eighth domain. The concrete opportunity E088 leaves open — whether fault/error-code domains hold needs that are unserved — can now be addressed by population measurement using this validated instrument, rather than by another screen of the same broken classifier.

discrimination_test_status: PASSED — simplified instrument passes G1 on E091 labels known by construction
labels_known_by_construction: 14 served, 4 partially_served, 17 unserved across 35 E083 treatment queries, classified from query text alone using rubric written before viewing results. These hand classifications are the ground truth that enables instrument validation.
experiment_significance: This experiment resolves a multi-session deadlock: E088-E090 established that classify_served / Bing + keywords fundamentally cannot separate served from unserved needs in technical fault-code domains (G1 FAIL every time). E091 established the 'read by hand' step and provided hand-classified ground truth. E092 demonstrates that a different, much simpler instrument design CAN pass the discrimination test on those same ground-truth labels. This opens the path from 'no candidate validated' to a viable instrument + population measurement pipeline.
